purpose: Stores metadata and storage references for photos attached to owner listings.

important_fields.name: listing_id
important_fields.note: References the parent PG listing; media cannot exist without a listing.

important_fields.name: storage_key
important_fields.note: External object-storage reference used to locate the uploaded file.

important_fields.name: file_url
important_fields.note: Resolved access URL or path used to render the media in the application.

important_fields.name: caption
important_fields.note: Optional owner-supplied context for the image.

important_fields.name: sort_order
important_fields.note: Controls display ordering of listing photos.

important_fields.name: is_primary
important_fields.note: Marks the main image used for listing previews.

important_fields.name: deleted_at
important_fields.note: Soft delete marker for recoverable media removal.

relationships.note: Each media item belongs to one listing.

notes: The database stores metadata only; the actual file is kept in external storage.
At most one active media row per listing should be flagged as the primary image.
Soft-deleted media should not be shown in owner or user-facing listing views.
